name: The Clockwork Deep
about: The Clockwork Deep: a vertical dungeon below the Great Forge, built by dwarves and gnomes nine centuries ago to tend Gorrak's prison. Brass gear-trains taller than houses, steam, rails and chain-lifts; lit by furnace bellies, ember cracks and cold-blue binding runes. One long hall, rooms in order from the south: C0 The Lift, C1 Gearworks Hall, C2 The Drive Shaft, C3 The Glowpool Cistern (later rooms C4-C8 and the boss continue north).
